_comment: Hawk reference calibration: model (h, v) mm -> page px (u, v) = A @ [h, v, 1]. Images are not in git (ref/ is ignored).

plan._source: Revell 04284 Hawk T.1A Red Arrows instructions p15, top view (nose right, starboard down), 400 dpi. Scale from the span (avg of both halves, 1968 px = 234.75 mm): 0.11928 mm/px. Nose tip (white radome outline) at u 2645, centreline v 3300. Note: the artwork's wings sit ~20 px below the fuselage centreline.

under._source: Same kit, p16 underside view (nose left, starboard down). Span 1972 px.

side._source: p16 starboard side view (nose right). Drawn ~12% larger than the plan views: 0.10598 mm/px, from nose (u 2940) to jet pipe end (u 447) = 264.2 mm. z = 0 at the nose tip (v 1335).
